all.source_quote: all landholding farmers’ families in the country, having cultivable land

unmodelled.text: No family member holds or held a constitutional post
unmodelled.source_quote: Former and present holders of constitutional posts

unmodelled.text: No family member is or was a Minister, MP, MLA, MLC, Mayor or District Panchayat Chairperson
unmodelled.source_quote: Former and present Ministers/ State Ministers and former/present Members of Lok Sabha/ Rajya Sabha/ State Legislative Assemblies/ State Legislative Councils

unmodelled.text: No family member is a serving or retired government or PSE employee (Group D / MTS excepted)
unmodelled.source_quote: All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/ State Government Ministries

unmodelled.text: Not a person who paid income tax in the last assessment year
unmodelled.source_quote: All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.

unmodelled.text: Not a retired pensioner with monthly pension of Rs 10,000 or more
unmodelled.source_quote: All superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs.10,000/-or more

unmodelled.text: Not a practising registered professional (doctor, engineer, lawyer, CA, architect)
unmodelled.source_quote: Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies

unmodelled.text: Land must be owned as per state land records
unmodelled.source_quote: who own cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT

en.title: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
en.benefit: Rs 6,000 per year paid directly into the bank account of eligible farmer families.
en.how_to_apply: Beneficiaries are identified by the State or UT government from land records and uploaded to the PM-KISAN portal.
